newsitem.title: JAPAN: Penalties on Nomura may affect stock market -- TSE.
newsitem.headline: Penalties on Nomura may affect stock market -- TSE.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange's president Mitsuhide Yamaguchi said on Tuesday that the securities watchdog's recommendation of penalties against Nomura Securities Co Ltd may have a certain impact on the stock market if the brokerage's operations are restricted.
Yamaguchi also said that the bourse should consider raising fines on member brokerages that breach its rules.
He also said the exchange may need to consider increasing the number of stocks on which options are offered.

The Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) proposed on Tuesday that the finance minister impose administrative penalties against Nomura Securities for violating the Securities and Exchange Law.
The watchdog also said that Japan's biggest brokerage was at fault for inadequate internal controls.
